name: active-platform
description: Find and manage your Active clients and client groups, their documents, and workpaper binders (trial balance / ledger) -- the firm's client book / CRM -- through the Active MCP server. Includes document I/O: fetch a document to disk, edit it with any tool, and upload it back as a new version, with Claude moving the bytes itself and asking you to approve each transfer. Plus the Workpapers client-queries skill suite. Requires an Active Platform subscription. Nothing extra to install.
